sections.title: Form and cultivation
sections.text: Cultivated oat is an annual cereal domesticated from Eurasian wild oats and grown mainly in temperate regions. Its upright culms are about 40–180 cm tall; the loose drooping panicle is commonly 20–40 cm long and carries spikelets with the grain.

sections.title: Food and image
sections.text: The grain is eaten by people and is also a major livestock feed. The tufted habit, open hanging panicles and spikelets in the plate fit cultivated oat.
